title: CryptoPunks Daily Floor Price 2017-2026
subtitle: CryptoPunks floor since 2017 and PNKSTR premium, rebuilt from on-chain data
description:
# CryptoPunks daily floor price, 2017 to today

The daily CryptoPunks floor from 23 June 2017 onwards, rebuilt from the CryptoPunks marketplace contract's own events. One row per UTC day, no gaps.

**Method.** Every PunkOffered, PunkNoLongerForSale, PunkBought and PunkTransfer event since the contract's genesis block (about 240,000 events) is replayed in block and log order. An offer stays open until the next event for the same punk. The floor for a day is the lowest *public* ask open at 23:59:59 UTC. Offers reserved for one buyer are excluded. Nothing is estimated or taken from an aggregator.

**Verified.** Checked against the contract's own state (punksOfferedForSale for all 10,000 punks at the last block of the day) on every disputed day sampled.

**Also included:** the PunkStrategy (PNKSTR) premium to its treasury, daily since September 2025.

Chart, live CSV/JSON API and full methodology: https://punkprice.com/data
Source, SQL version and verification script: https://github.com/ZonnetjeAXIOM/cryptopunks-floor

**Cite as:** PunkPrice (2026). CryptoPunks daily floor price, reconstructed from the CryptoPunks marketplace contract. https://punkprice.com/data

resources.description: CryptoPunks floor, one row per UTC day since 2017-06-23 with no gaps: the lowest public ask on the marketplace contract at 23:59:59 UTC, in ETH and USD, with the punk at the floor and the size of the order book.

fields.name: floor_eth
fields.description: Lowest public ask open at 23:59:59 UTC, in ETH. Offers reserved for one buyer are excluded

fields.name: floor_usd
fields.description: floor_eth x eth_usd, rounded to cents. Empty when that day's ETH price is unknown

fields.name: eth_usd
fields.description: ETH price in USD at the end of that UTC day (DefiLlama). Empty when unknown

fields.name: floor_punk_index
fields.description: Index (0-9999) of the punk offered at the floor price

fields.name: active_asks
fields.description: All offers open on the contract at that moment, public and private

fields.name: source
fields.description: onchain-orderbook when the contract saw marketplace activity that day, onchain-carried when the previous day's order book stood unchanged

resources.description: PunkStrategy (PNKSTR) premium, one row per UTC day since 2025-09-15: the token's market cap divided by the fair market value of its treasury (punks held x CryptoPunks floor, plus unallocated ETH).

fields.name: premium_x
fields.description: pnkstr_market_cap_usd / asset_fmv_usd. 1.0 means the token trades at exactly its treasury value

fields.name: asset_fmv_usd
fields.description: Treasury fair market value in USD: (punks_held x cryptopunks_floor_eth + unallocated_eth) x eth_price_usd

fields.name: punks_held
fields.description: CryptoPunks held by the PunkStrategy treasury that day

fields.name: unallocated_eth
fields.description: ETH held by the treasury and not yet spent on punks

fields.name: cryptopunks_floor_eth
fields.description: CryptoPunks floor used for the valuation, in ETH (same series as cryptopunks-daily-floor.csv)

fields.name: eth_price_usd
fields.description: ETH price in USD that day (DefiLlama)

fields.name: pnkstr_circulating_supply
fields.description: Implied circulating supply: market cap / price

userSpecifiedSources: Floor: replayed from the CryptoPunks marketplace contract (0xb47e3cd837ddf8e4c57f05d70ab865de6e193bbb), every PunkOffered, PunkNoLongerForSale, PunkBought and PunkTransfer event since genesis, fetched via Etherscan and checked against contract state (punksOfferedForSale). ETH/USD: DefiLlama daily close. PNKSTR price, market cap and volume: CoinGecko. PunkStrategy treasury (punks held, unallocated ETH): read from the treasury's on-chain holdings and balance. Collected and published daily by PunkPrice (https://punkprice.com/about); source and verification script at https://github.com/ZonnetjeAXIOM/cryptopunks-floor.
